parole.significato: pomace, lees, dregs, residual mash (after pressing olives or grapes)
parole.testo: From Proto-Albanian *britśiā, closely related to Latin brisa (“husks of grapes”). The further origin is uncertain; perhaps also cognate to Ancient Greek βρύτεα (brútea).
